The '''Slotern system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Wazta sector/Legends|Wazta sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Slotern]].
